purpose: Teach: 目下/下車/一向に/終結/逸脱/釈放/破棄/自爆

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、目下の重要事件として捜査しております
lines.en: We're currently investigating this as a high-priority case.
lines.style: Professional and measured. Clear diction on key procedural terms. Steady, level delivery without inflection. The calm of someone who has delivered this statement many times before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者は途中駅で下車されたんですね
lines.en: So the suspect got off at an intermediate station, then?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, not challenging. Slight uptick at the end—a real question seeking confirmation. Engaged but respectful of the officer's authority. Careful phrasing shows he's paying close attention.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪発生が一向に減らない地区を集中警備します
lines.en: We're increasing patrols in districts where crime hasn't decreased.
lines.style: Factual, authoritative statement. Even pace throughout. No apologetic softening—this is operational reality. Slight emphasis on the commitment to action, not blame.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、紛争の終結に警察も貢献されたんですね
lines.en: So the police did play a part in bringing this conflict to an end.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost gently acknowledging. Slight pause before speaking, as if turning something over. Voice drops slightly—not a question but an observation seeking quiet confirmation. Respectful tone.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、規則からの逸脱を厳しく咎めます
lines.en: We enforce regulations strictly—deviations are not tolerated.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Sharp consonants on the procedural language. Posture is upright, resolute. This isn't a threat, it's a statement of institutional principle. No wavering.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、釈放後の追跡を警察、続けておられますね
lines.en: You're saying the department is still tracking them after release.
lines.style: Softer realization dawning. Breath slightly held before speaking, as if putting pieces together. Voice trails up gently at the end—not quite a question, more acknowledgment. Quieter than before.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、押収証拠の破棄は行いません
lines.en: We don't dispose of seized evidence.
lines.style: Simple, declarative. Almost factual in its understatement. Even breath. This is not a boast—it's a statement of procedure that stands on its own. Steady, unbending.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、自爆テロを警察、未然に防がれたんですね
lines.en: So you did manage to prevent that attack before it happened.
lines.style: Quiet respect and relief underneath. Very slight tremor of emotion held back. Long exhale at the very end, like something tense finally releasing. Voice becomes smaller, more intimate than before.
